chunks: As for what al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Aban ibn 'Uthman, from Muhammad al-Halabi, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about a man who becomes junub in a garment, or urine affects it, and he has no garment other than it. He said: He prays in it if he is compelled to use it.

key_terms.الثَّوْبِ: the garment or clothing being discussed
key_terms.يُجْنِبُ: becomes in a state of janabah

ai.seo_question: Can a person pray in a garment contaminated by janabah or urine if no other clothing is available?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one whose only garment has become affected by janabah or urine. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that if he is compelled and has no other garment, he may perform salat in it.
